description: Regional festivals for Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand shopkeepers

events.name: Kumbh Mela (Prayagraj)
events.stock_hint: Pooja items, Flowers, Dry fruits, Pilgrimage supplies — crores of pilgrims

events.name: Holi (Mathura/Vrindavan)
events.stock_hint: Gulal, Phoolon wali Holi items, Pichkari, Thandai — world-famous Holi

events.name: Ram Navami (Ayodhya)
events.stock_hint: Prasad, Panchamrit, Flowers, Sweets — Ayodhya Ram Mandir draws crores

events.name: Akshaya Tritiya (UP)
events.stock_hint: Gold, Sweets, Dry fruits, Gift boxes

events.name: Eid (Lucknow/UP)
events.stock_hint: Sewai, Dates, Biryani masala, Ittar, Sherwanis — UP large Muslim community

events.name: Janmashtami (Mathura)
events.stock_hint: Makhan, Mishri, Dahi, Sweets, Panjiri — massive demand in Mathura/Vrindavan

events.name: Chhath Puja (UP/Bihar belt)
events.stock_hint: Thekua, Gur, Sugarcane, Fruits, Bamboo soop — Eastern UP huge

events.name: Diwali (UP)
events.stock_hint: Mithai (Gujiya, Peda, Rewri), Diyas, Fireworks, Namkeen, Dry fruits

events.name: Char Dham Yatra Season
events.stock_hint: Pilgrim supplies, Dry fruits, Warm clothes, Trekking snacks
